segments.text: Hello everyone, welcome to this English lesson today.
We will learn useful expressions through a short story.
Listen carefully and repeat each sentence for better pronunciation.
The main character faced many challenges but never gave up hope.
She worked hard every day and practiced speaking with confidence.
Eventually her effort paid off and she achieved her dream goal.
This story teaches us that persistence and courage matter most.
Remember to review the vocabulary cards after finishing the script.
Thank you for studying with us and see you in the next lesson.
Keep practicing and you will improve step by step every week.
Success comes to those who continue even when progress feels slow.
Believe in yourself and keep moving forward with patience.
Every small step builds stronger English skills over time.
Your dedication today will create better results tomorrow.
